$comment: Every cookie and storage key the Lucida browser SDK writes. Published for consent managers (Cookie Munch preset, docs/integrations/cookiemunch-preset.md). sdks/browser/test/storage-manifest.test.ts fails when the SDK source names an lc_* key that is not listed here.

suffix_rule.rule: name + '_' + the last 8 word characters of the project's public key (key.replace(/\W/g, '').slice(-8))
suffix_rule.why: several projects can share one page without sharing state

persistence_modes.memory: nothing is written to the browser
persistence_modes.none: nothing is written to the browser (cookieless; events carry no distinct id until identify)
persistence_modes.localStorage: keys with store 'persistence' are in localStorage (default)
persistence_modes.sessionStorage: keys with store 'persistence' are in sessionStorage
persistence_modes.localStorage+cookie: keys with cookie_in_combined: true are written to a cookie and localStorage; the other 'persistence' keys to localStorage only

expiry.cookie: Max-Age = cookie.expiryDays * 86400 seconds; default 365 days (cookie.expiryDays). Path=/, SameSite=Lax, Secure on https, Domain only with cookie.crossSubdomain or cookie.domain.
expiry.localStorage: no browser expiry (the SDK never writes an expiry; lc_click_ids remembers ids for clickIds.expiryDays, default 90, inside its value)

categories.necessary: records the visitor's own consent decision
categories.statistics: the SDK's consent categories 'analytics' and 'replay'; written only after analytics (or, for lc_replay_ack, replay) consent
categories.marketing: the SDK's consent category 'marketing'. The SDK writes no key in this category: marketing consent is recorded and sent with events, and it gates nothing in browser storage

consent_notes: lc_consent is written on every explicit decision, including a decline, and stays after a decline: it is how the choice is remembered. Every other key is purged (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage) when analytics is declined.

With consent.mode opt_in (or a project consent_mode of opt_in, which a page cannot loosen) nothing is written before the visitor decides except lc_consent after the decision. See testdata/consent/precedence.json.
consentPersistence moves lc_consent to its own persistence mode; consent.storageKey renames it (the suffix rule still applies).

keys.name: lc_consent
keys.purpose: the visitor's consent decision {analytics, replay, marketing}; stays after a decline

keys.name: lc_person_identified
keys.purpose: personProfiles identified_only: this visitor has been identified

keys.name: lc_pending_set_once
keys.purpose: first-touch properties kept while the visitor is personless

keys.name: lc_click_ids
keys.purpose: ad click ids (gclid, fbclid, ...) of the landing visit, kept clickIds.expiryDays (default 90); off with clickIds: false

keys.name: lc_flag_initial
keys.purpose: first-seen request properties sent with flag requests

keys.name: lc_rt_events
keys.purpose: event counters for runtime flag conditions

keys.name: lc_guide_last
keys.purpose: time the last guide was shown (frequency capping)

keys.name: lc_offline
keys.purpose: undeliverable event batches, replayed when back online (sessionStorage when persistence is sessionStorage; never written in memory/none; off with offlineQueue: false)

keys.name: lc_replay_ack
keys.purpose: the session id whose recording was acknowledged; written only while recording

keys.name: lc_preview
keys.purpose: experiment QA link (?lc_preview=flag:variant) for this tab; written only when that URL parameter is present

keys.name: lc_flag_overrides
keys.purpose: flag overrides set from the toolbar by a signed-in teammate; never written for visitors

keys.name: lc_toolbar_session
keys.purpose: toolbar authorization of a signed-in teammate; written only after a toolbar token exchange

keys.name: lc_toolbar_edit
keys.purpose: experiment being edited in the toolbar; teammates only

keys.name: lc_toolbar_check
keys.purpose: toolbar check to run once; teammates only

keys.name: lc_toolbar_recording
keys.purpose: guide recording in progress in the toolbar; teammates only

not_storage.$comment: lc_* names the SDK source mentions that are never written to cookies or web storage: URL parameters and flag payload keys.
